note: GB means 10^9 bytes throughout; AWS bills 2^30-byte units, about 7 % fewer billed units than this table counts. Every AWS price below was read from the AWS Price List API (pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/<service>/current/us-east-1/index.json) on 2026-10-28; the offer version is given per service. The Firebase and data-transfer rows could not be fetched from this sandbox (firebase.google.com and aws.amazon.com are blocked) and are written from memory of the public price pages: verify them against the page before quoting.

not_costed: Firebase: Cloud Functions for the offline detector and notifications (free quota covers a small fleet), Authentication (free), the console
AWS: the scheduled Lambda that reads the status table for the offline detector, the API behind the app's chart (API Gateway or AppSync), CloudWatch, Route 53
self-hosted: the domain and TLS certificate (Let's Encrypt is free), the monitoring stack, and any second region
